answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 22297 Country: India Title: My question is regarding the division of property.There are 4 sons with a daughter and mother. what should be the percentage of division of property among sons, daughter and the mother.what percentage should each son,daughter and mother get respectively? Question: assalamualaikum My question is regarding the division of property.There are 4 sons with a daughter and mother. what should be the percentage of division of property among sons, daughter and the mother.what percentage should each son,daughter and mother get respectively? JazakAllah!! Answer ID: 22297 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 833/590/L=1431) After due rights preceding inheritance, all the property of the deceased shall be distributed in 54 shares; out of the total 9 shares will go to his mother and each son will get 10 shares while the daughter will get 5 shares. Detail: Mother: 9 Son: 10x4= 40 Daughter: 5 Total: 54 Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
